label: PF Backlog 473
title: API-first: web_search settings API (GET/PUT /api/v1/tools/web-search) + settings/secret store
body:
Source: user request (2026-10-08): anything we build must be API-first; web_search settings need an API
(and later a dashboard) so a customer can set backend + their own cloud key/account at ship time.

Goal (BI-PF-0438 follow-up): expose the web_search configuration through an API-first settings surface.

Scope:
- core/tool_settings.py (single writer): reads/writes non-secret settings (backend, url) and the secret key,
  with precedence ENV > store (env still wins, e.g. PF_WEB_SEARCH_BACKEND). Secret key is stored in a GITIGNORED
  file and is NEVER returned by the API (only has_key: true/false).
- New stores (registered in config/store-registry.json, single writer = core/tool_settings.py):
  data/tools/settings.json (non-secret) + data/tools/secrets.json (gitignored).
- API (new router api/routers/tools.py, prefix /tools):
    GET  /api/v1/tools/web-search   (authenticate) -> {backend, url, has_key, source}
    PUT  /api/v1/tools/web-search   (require_operator) {backend, url?, api_key?} -> validate + persist
  Registered in api/app.py; OpenAPI + api docs regenerated.
- core/tool_registry._ws_cfg reads tool_settings (env overrides), so agents get the configured backend.

Out of scope (follow-ups): dashboard UI surface; more cloud adapters; secret rotation/audit.

Security: the key is never stored in a committed config, never returned by the API; operator role required to set.

dashboard_impact: needs_dashboard=false for THIS item (API-first); a dashboard settings view is a separate
follow-up so the dashboard stays out of this slice.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/artifact_store.py, core/asset_store.py, core/budget.py, core/budget_allocator.py

dashboard_impact.reason: API-first settings surface; dashboard view is a separate follow-up
